description: BPT (blocked and patchified tokenization, 500M parameters, 8-16 block and offset size): an autoregressive transformer conditioned on a point cloud with normals sampled from a dense mesh, which writes a new mesh of 1,000 to 5,000 faces in an artist-like face layout (at most about 8,000 faces). The point-cloud encoder (Michelangelo) is part of this checkpoint. The checkpoint file's card is MIT licensed; the code carries the Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 Community License.
